detail.title: Synthesis of Curious Exploration Mechanisms and Affective Learning
detail.summary: This cycle transitions the curiosity-mechanisms project to a preliminary synthesis, utilizing findings from information-gap theories and generative AI's impact on learner affect. The music-mechanisms project remains active but requires additional focused research to bridge the gap between emotion tagging and cognitive prediction error processing.
